Skill `git-workflow-manager`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `query_git_context` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; adds `git_context_known`.
Tool `review_repository_state` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `shell`, `linux`, `local_filesystem`; adds `repository_state_reviewed`.
Tool `review_workflow_files` (owner `agent`): via `read`; needs `local_filesystem`; adds `workflow_files_reviewed`.
Tool `implement_workflow_files` (owner `agent`): via `write`; needs `local_filesystem`; requires `workflow_design_ready`; adds `workflow_files_updated`, `documentation_complete`, `automated_pr_checks_configured`, `automated_releases_ready`.
Tool `edit_existing_workflow_files` (owner `agent`): via `edit`; needs `local_filesystem`; requires `workflow_design_ready`; adds `workflow_files_updated`, `documentation_complete`, `automated_pr_checks_configured`, `automated_releases_ready`.
Tool `configure_git_repository` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `shell`, `linux`, `local_filesystem`; requires `workflow_design_ready`; adds `branching_model_established`, `signed_commits_implemented`, `clean_history_maintained`, `fast_forward_only_enforced`.
Tool `report_completion` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; requires all of (`branching_model_established`, `automated_pr_checks_configured`, `documentation_complete`); adds `user_informed`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: all of (`git_context_known`, `repository_state_reviewed`, `workflow_files_reviewed`, `branching_model_established`, `automated_pr_checks_configured`, `signed_commits_implemented`, `clean_history_maintained`, `fast_forward_only_enforced`, `automated_releases_ready`, `documentation_complete`).
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `query_git_context`.
  - `agent` uses `review_repository_state`.
  - `agent` uses `review_workflow_files`.
  - `user` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `workflow_design_ready`:
      - `agent` uses `configure_git_repository`.
      - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `write_new_files`:
          - `agent` uses `implement_workflow_files`.
        - branch `edit_existing_files`:
          - `agent` uses `edit_existing_workflow_files`.
      - `agent` uses `report_completion`.
    - branch `no_changes_requested`: none.
